Market today: Tech sentiment is shaky, driven by AI disruption fears and rising rates hitting financials. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially leveraged names, feels this pressure acutely.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.39%) and SPAL (-28.23%) are the clear SELL/TRIM signals needing attention. They are leveraged, decay-prone, and deep in the red.

Watch: The AI infrastructure trade (Headline 6) and CoreWeave's potential comeback (Headline 7) are relevant to your sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, losing positions and watching for any signs of AI sector resilience.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given its deep loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF due to its significant loss.
META: Watch for a move towards the 735.86-735.12 entry range if the AI narrative gains traction.
